# Pandit Ji Online (पण्डित जी ऑनलाइन)
> Authentic Vedic Astrology, Lahiri Chitra Paksha Drik Ganit Panchang, 36 Gun Kundli Milan, Sampurn Janam Kundli, Digital Mandir, and Shastrokta Muhurat & Dosha Remedies by Acharya Pandit Shashank Sharma (Rudrapur, Uttarakhand, India).

## Core Interactive Vedic Calculators & Services
- [Home & Live Drik Ganit Panchang](https://www.panditjionline.online/): Daily Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, Karana, Rahukaal, Abhijit Muhurat, and Choghadiya.
- [Sampurn Janam Kundli](https://www.panditjionline.online/janam-kundali): Free Lagna Chart (D-1), Navamsha (D-9), Vimshottari Dasha, and PDF Patrika.
- [36 Gun Kundli Milan](https://www.panditjionline.online/kundali-milan): Ashtakoot marriage compatibility, Manglik check, and Nadi/Bhakoot Parihar.
- [Shubh Muhurat & Naam Rashi](https://www.panditjionline.online/shubh-muhurat): Auspicious dates and name-based Rashi/Nakshatra calculator.
- [Digital Mandir](https://www.panditjionline.online/digital-mandir): Interactive Sanatan shrine with live Aarti, Shankhnaad, and 108 Mantra Jaap Mala.
- [Jyotish AI Consultation](https://www.panditjionline.online/jyotish-ai): 24x7 Vedic astrology guidance with Acharya Pandit Shashank Sharma.
